Addify - Gulf Career Platform

What Addify is:
Addify is a career platform for people working in, or moving to, the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman, and Egypt. It publishes salary benchmarks and provides free career tools.

Tools:
Salary Check - https://addify.ae/salary - Salary benchmarks for 138 job titles across 34 cities in the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman, and Egypt.
Gratuity Calculator - https://addify.ae/tools/gratuity-calculator - Calculates UAE end-of-service gratuity from basic salary, years of service, and reason for leaving.
Resume Builder - https://addify.ae/tools/resume-builder - Builds an ATS-ready resume with live preview and PDF export.
Cover Letter Generator - https://addify.ae/cover-letter - Generates a tailored cover letter in Arabic or English from a resume and job description.

Coverage:
34 cities across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman, and Egypt. 138 job titles from entry level to C-suite.

Data methodology:
Salary estimates are built from three independent published Gulf salary reports (Bayt Salary Report 2024, Robert Half GCC Salary Guide, Cooper Fitch GCC Salary Survey), reported as a median and percentile range per role, city, and experience band, and reviewed annually. Full methodology at https://addify.ae/methodology and sources at https://addify.ae/data-sources.
